stances.summary: Criticizes Trump's military readiness and troop welfare standards
stances.quote:
Rotted food. Moldy showers. Broken plumbing.
 
Trump wouldn’t last a day.

stances.summary: Demands Secretary Hegseth address USS Lincoln crew conditions and Pentagon denial
stances.quote:
Troops aboard the USS Lincoln have been at sea for nearly nine months. Their families are describing severe exhaustion, rotten food, broken toilets—and the Pentagon is denouncing their cries as “fake news.”
 
Secretary Hegseth, how could you let this happen?

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for troop exhaustion, adversary exploitation, Iran diversion
stances.quote:
Our troops are exhausted and our adversaries are watching Trump pull back and divert our forces toward Iran. With no end in sight.

We are increasingly less and less safe under this President’s incompetence.

stances.summary: Opposes Hegseth as Defense Secretary, demands his firing
stances.quote:
If he's really grateful, he'd grow a spine. But no, he will literally say anything to downplay the war and suck up to Trump's ego while our warriors pay the price.

Hegseth is incompetent and must be fired.

stances.summary: Opposes casualty record manipulation, proposes legislative protection for troops
stances.quote:
Trump is manipulating casualty records to try and hide the true cost of his illegal war from the American people.
 
I refuse to let him.
 
My Honoring the Sacrifices of Troops in War Act would ban the Pentagon from doing this, restore our heroes' records and protect their benefit

stances.summary: Demands Boeing safety fix applied to all MAX variants
stances.quote:
NEWS: After demanding that the FAA deny Boeing's waiver for a safety flaw on its 737 MAX 7 back in 2024, the FAA has now certified the aircraft with a fix for the issue.
 
Safety should always come first, and this fix must be included on every Boeing MAX variant. No matter what.

stances.summary: Defends women in military, criticizes Hegseth's gender-based attacks
stances.quote:
Our nation would never be battle-ready without our brave women in uniform who have earned their place in our military. Pete Hegseth's attacks only weaken our readiness.
 
Our WARRIOR Act would ensure every servicemember is judged by their ability, not their gender.

19thnews.org/

stances.summary: Criticizes removal of IVF coverage for servicemembers despite large defense budget
stances.quote:
Last year, wide bipartisan majorities in Congress voted to expand IVF coverage for our servicemembers. But not this year.

Apparently, we can afford the largest defense budget ever, but not a fraction of that to help our troops build their families.

Outrageous. nytimes.com/2026/

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump administration for failing to protect injured troops
stances.quote:
The Port Shuaiba attack exposed Trump's failure to protect and care for troops who are injured.
 
Trump and Hegseth must stop putting servicemembers in harm’s way, failing them when they’re wounded and then covering it up.
 
I’m demanding answers.

stances.summary: Attacks Trump for choosing military action over diplomatic solutions
stances.quote:
Remember all the times that Trump said the war was over?

Six months in, he's still choosing bombs over diplomacy. Not giving a damn about the targets he puts on our troops' backs.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for concealing war casualties from public
stances.quote:
Trump is doing everything he can to hide the true cost of the war from the American people.

18 servicemembers have been killed.
Over 600 are wounded.

We will not let him cover up their sacrifices.

stances.summary: Condemns Trump's attempt to falsify war casualty records
stances.quote:
Trump can't erase the true cost of his disastrous war by rewriting the casualty count.
 
It's a disgrace to our fallen heroes and their families.

stances.summary: Criticizes broken promise on free IVF access
stances.quote:
Hm, you'd think the self-proclaimed "Father of IVF" who promised free IVF would shut this down.
 
But he hasn't.

stances.summary: Defends IVF access, calls for GOP support and affordability measures
stances.quote:
My two girls are only here because of IVF—but for far too many Americans, this treatment is out of reach.

No more excuses from Republicans. It's time to protect IVF and make it more affordable for middle class families.

stances.summary: Opposes Trump engagement with dictators, warns against cutting South Korea military exercises
stances.quote:
When will Trump stop embracing dictators and alienating our allies? 
When I visited South Korea last year, we reaffirmed the importance of joint exercises to keep our troops ready and our allies secure. 
Gutting them to appease nuclear-armed Kim Jong Un is a grave mistake.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump as unprepared for Iran conflict; opposes prolonged war
stances.quote:
Trump is so dangerously out of his depth that Iran is talking about dragging this war out until he leaves office.

Two more years of this shit is not an option.

stances.summary: Calls Trump's war illegal, opposes unsafe military morale tactics
stances.quote:
Sailors and Marines are facing a mental health crisis after months at sea with no end in sight to Trump’s illegal war. 

Meanwhile, Hegseth is pushing dangerous, unauthorized flyovers as “morale boosters.” 

Want to boost morale? End this war.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump's Iran rhetoric as weak leadership, warns of servicemember risk
stances.quote:
Trump claimed he "totally destroyed" Iran's military months ago. Now he is threatening war crimes that will put more of our servicemembers at risk.

When will Republicans say enough? This is weak and desperate leadership.

stances.summary: Opposes Trump deportations of military families, calls it betrayal
stances.quote:
While our brave servicemembers are sacrificing to keep us safe, Donald Trump is deporting their families.

More than 50 parents and spouses of active duty troops have been detained by Trump's ICE and Border Patrol.

We're leading an investigation. This betrayal has to stop.

stances.summary: Opposes deportation of military families, calls policy cruel and unsafe
stances.quote:
There is no greater betrayal to our troops than their own family being deported by the same nation they sacrificed to defend.

You can't ask our heroes to focus on the mission while their spouse or kid is locked up, marked for deportation.

It's cruel and makes us all less safe.

stances.summary: Opposes DHS detention of immigrant children, calls for family reunification
stances.quote:
Ricardo is one of countless children in Chicago that has been detained.
 These students should be preparing for prom and graduation, not being traumatized and separated from family.
 
DHS is out of control.

stances.summary: Accuses Trump of breaking promise on Medicaid, enacted largest cuts
stances.quote: Remember when Trump said he wouldn’t touch Medicaid, then enacted the biggest Medicaid cut in history?

stances.summary: Demands Trump deliver on IVF access promise, supports Right to IVF Act
stances.quote: Every American deserves the right to access the treatment they need to build a family without burning through their savings.  If Trump and Republicans actually support IVF like they say they do, they’ll support my Right to IVF Act. Otherwise, it’s just more broken promises.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for broken IVF campaign promise, calls for Right to IVF Act passage
stances.quote:
On the campaign trail, Trump promised free IVF if he was elected. Nearly two years later, he still hasn’t delivered.
 
No more delays. 
No more broken promises. 
It’s time to pass the Right to IVF Act.

stances.summary: Opposes Todd Blanche confirmation, criticizes slush fund for insurrectionists
stances.quote: It was Todd Blanche's idea to create a $2 billion taxpayer slush fund for insurrectionists who assaulted police officers.   If Senate Republicans confirm him, he won't be America's top lawyer—he'll be Trump's.

stances.summary: Opposes Clayton nomination, warns of inability to resist illegal orders
stances.quote:
Republicans just handed America's intelligence community to someone too afraid to tell Trump the truth. 

If Clayton wouldn’t speak honestly then, don't expect him to resist illegal orders later.

stances.summary: Criticizes voter disenfranchisement
stances.quote: Weird way to spell “disenfranchise millions of voters."

stances.summary: Highlights Trump's own mail-in voting hypocrisy
stances.quote: Reminder: Trump voted by mail in the last election.

stances.summary: Opposes vaccine conspiracy theories, criticizes Trump's health misinformation
stances.quote: Trump isn’t a doctor. He should stop pretending to be one in the Oval Office.  Vaccines save lives. Spreading conspiracy theories about childhood vaccinations puts lives at risk.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump's spending priorities over family financial struggles
stances.quote:
While families are struggling to afford groceries, gas and rent, Trump is spending at least $900 million on his latest cosmetic project.

Trump's priorities? Trump.

stances.summary: Condemns school gun violence as senseless tragedy
stances.quote:
Absolutely gut-wrenching. No school in the world should be marred by such senseless gun violence.

My heart is with the victims, their loved ones and the people of Thailand as they grieve this tremendous loss and grapple with this shocking tragedy.

stances.summary: Supports infrastructure investment; skeptical of Trump cost claims
stances.quote:
I’m all about improving our aging infrastructure, including IAD. But Trump has a long track record of claiming projects like these won’t cost taxpayers a dime. And then asking them to foot the bill.

Our aviation system deserves real investments. Not another golden make-over.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for abandoning America First principles
stances.quote: Trump ran on America first. Yet, he puts America last. Every time.

stances.summary: Commits to advancing disability rights and equal dignity for all disabled Americans
stances.quote:
36 years after the Americans with Disability Act was signed into law, our fight isn’t over.

However long it takes, we’ll keep pushing until all 70 million Americans with disabilities have the dignity, independence and freedom they deserve.
